{{Quote|Later, when this is all over, I'll ask the commander for an interview. I hope she'll share what she was thinking in those moments.|Voren Na'al, to Arhul Hextrophon in a report regarding "[[Official History of the Rebel Movements, Volume One]]"|<ref name="Rebel Dossier" />}}
'''Voren Na'al''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[historian]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[New Republic]]. Na'al served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance Military|military]] of the Alliance around the time of the [[Battle of Scarif]]. At the time, he was working on a project titled "[[Official History of the Rebel Movements, Volume One]]" with [[Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon]]. He served as an Alliance [[archivist]] by the time of the [[Battle of Hoth]].

==Biography==
===Historian for the Rebellion===
Voren Na'al was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="anh" /> who served as a [[lieutenant]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> and [[historian]]<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> in the [[Alliance Military|military]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] around the time of the [[Battle of Scarif]]. At the time, he was working on a project titled "[[Official History of the Rebel Movements, Volume One]]" with [[Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon]]. Na'al was in the briefing room at [[Great Temple|Base One]] when [[Jyn Erso]] was brought before [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]] and the rest of the [[Alliance High Command]], and he summarized the proceedings of this meeting in a report to Hextrophon. He also intended to interview Mon Mothma after the battle was over. This report was later included in a [[Operation Fracture dossier|compilation of documents]] prepared by [[General]] [[Airen Cracken]], [[Chief]] of [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|Rebel Intelligence]], for Mothma.<ref name="Rebel Dossier" /> In a correspondence with Mothma titled "DOC #0320194-ALL" that was included in the collection of documents that became known as ''[[The Rebel Files]]'', Arhul Hextrophon mentioned Na'al's intention to interview her, and suspected he began writing his own book.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

[[File:LeiaHanMedal-ANH.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Na'al (far right) bears a Medal of Bravery at the award ceremony.]]
Later, Na'al was also at the [[Royal Award Ceremony|ceremony]] held in honor of [[Luke Skywalker]] and other heroes of the [[Battle of Yavin]]. He bore one of the [[Medal of Bravery|Medals of Bravery]], which General [[Jan Dodonna]] handed to [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan]], who awarded it to Skywalker.<ref name="anh" /> By the time of the [[Battle of Hoth]], Na'al served as an an [[archivist]] in the Alliance. Following the battle, lieutenant [[Wedge Antilles]] summarized the battle in a classified correspondence titled "RI 087-R2 Action on Hoth" to Na'al that was included in ''The Rebel Files''.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

===Historian for the New Republic and Resistance===
By the time of the [[New Republic]], Na'al had become a bona fide historian.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> At some point, he attended the [[Arhul Hextrophon School of Embedded Journalism]] on [[Lerct]], where he met fellow historian [[Beaumont Kin]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> After ''The Rebel Files'' were [[Excavation on Durkteel|rediscovered]] on [[Durkteel]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> in [[34 ABY]]<ref name="Date">Since ''[[The Rebel Files]]'' were buried on the same [[Standard day|day]] as the [[Battle of Endor]], which according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' takes place in [[4 ABY]], and because ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' establishes that ''The Rebel Files'' were rediscovered 30 [[Standard year|years]] after the battle, it can be determined that ''The Rebel Files'' were uncovered in [[34 ABY]].</ref> and handed to the [[Resistance]], "DOC #0320194-ALL" was annotated by [[Amilyn Holdo]] and [[Ushos O. Statura]]. Holdo mentioned that Na'al intended to have a two-hour lunch with her the next time he's on [[D'Qar]], and Statura noted his humble beginnings.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> By [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROS Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] to one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> Na'al and Kin maintained a correspondence.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Personality and traits==
Voren Na'al had [[Color|light]] skin and blond [[hair]].<ref name="anh" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voren Na'al originated as the [[in-universe]] "author" of several [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] sourcebooks published by [[West End Games]], beginning with ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'' in [[1989]]. The character went on to appear in several other reference books.<ref name="Pablog 59">{{Blog|pablog|59|Tales of the Big Green Bunny: Behind the Scenes of Gamer #4 — Voren Na'al}}</ref> In [[2012]], the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" feature in [[Star Wars Insider 133|''Star Wars Insider'' 133]] identified one of the extras who hand the medals to General Dodonna as Na'al, [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] establishing that film as his first appearance.<ref name="Star Wars Insider 133">{{InsiderCite|133|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Celebrating a Rebel Victory!}}</ref> The extra in question was [[Derek Lyons]], who also portrayed a member of the [[Rebel Honor Guard]] earlier in the same scene.<ref name="Lyons">{{WebCite|url=http://www.dereklyonssite.com/voren-naal-aka-the-medal-bearer.html|text=VOREN NA'AL AKA THE MEDAL BEARER|author=Lyons, Derek|work=[http://www.dereklyonssite.com DEREK LYONS OFFICIAL SITE]|archivedate=20190317194842}}</ref>

The character became [[canon]] when he was mentioned in the 2016 reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Rebel Dossier]]''.<ref name="Rebel Dossier" />
